blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) often fail midway through unseen long-horizon tasks. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) offers a remedy, but embodied RSI methods either refine the harness around a frozen executor and so cannot add a missing motion, or train the executor on persistent failures without asking whether a failure lies in how the executor is called or in what it can do. We ask when a self-improving embodied system should change the weights of its executor, and propose AdaRSI, an on-demand RSI framework for embodied agents. A coding agent first improves its skills and harness, then attributes persistent failures by retrying failing sub-steps from saved states, and fine-tunes only the sub-steps that remain unreliable, with demonstrations it collects itself and experience carried over from earlier tasks. On all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, with GR00T N1.5 as the executor and no human demonstrations, AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites and raises its success on unseen composite tasks from 4.6% to 13.8%. Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step, it reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations, and fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less.
blocks.zh: 预先训练的视觉语言行动模式(VLAs)往往在未见的长视野任务中落空。 递归自我改进(RSI)提供了一种补救办法,但包含的RSI方法要么在被冻结的执行人周围细化绑带,因此不能增加缺失的动作,要么对执行人进行关于持续失败的训练,而不问失败在于如何称呼执行人还是它能做什么. 我们问,自我改进的体现体系何时应改变其执行者的权重,并提出AdaRSI, 即一个针对体现的代理人的按需RSI框架。 一个编码代理首先提高自己的技能和利用,然后通过重试来自被保存状态的失败子步骤来属性持续的失败,并且对仍然不可靠的子步骤进行微调,其中的演示会收集自己和以往任务中结转的经验. 在RoboCasa365的所有50项目标任务中,以GR00T N1.5为执行者,没有人类示威,AdaRSI改进了所有三个套房的VLA,并将其在隐形复合任务上的成功率从4.6%提高到13.8%. 与每个子步骤的微调相比,它取得了略高的成功,同时只使用了28%的GPU时间和22%的自收集演示,没有牵引列车的微调则收益更小得多.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Pretrained vision-language-action models (VLAs) [ 21 , 11 , 1 ] can perform a wide range of manipulation tasks in diverse environments.
Recent models have also made progress on long-horizon tasks [ 27 , 22 ] .
Yet on unseen multi-step tasks they still often fail midway.
A robot may approach the wrong target, misjudge whether a step has succeeded, or fail to execute a required motion.
Some of these failures lie in how the VLA, acting as the executor, is called and others in what it can do, and the failure itself does not tell which.
blocks.zh:
预先训练的视觉-语言-行动模型[21,11,1]可以在不同的环境中执行广泛的操纵任务.
近期的模型在长距离任务上也取得了进展[27,22].
然而,在未见的多步骤任务中,它们仍然常常在中途失败。
机器人可能接近错误的目标,误判一个步骤是否成功,或者未能执行需要的运动.
其中一些失败在于作为执行者的VLA如何被叫来,而另一些则在于它能做什么,而失败本身却不能说出是什么.

blocks.en:
Recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which a system turns its own experience into persistent changes that make it better [ 4 , 37 , 3 ] , offers a way to repair such failures without collecting human demonstrations for every new task.
An embodied system, made of a coding agent, its skills and harness, and a low-level executor such as a VLA, can improve itself at two levels.
The harness, comprising the agent’s skills, its tools and the procedure that composes them, decides how the executor is called, while the executor’s weights decide what it can do.
blocks.zh:
不断自我改进(RSI),在这个系统中,一个系统将自身的经验转化为持久的变化,使其更加美好[4,37,3],提供了一个在不为每一项新任务收集人类演示的情况下修复这种失败的方法.
由编码代理人、其技能和利用以及VLA等低级执行者组成的一个内在系统可以在两个层面自我改进。
由代理人的技能、工具和制作程序构成的牵引力决定如何称呼执行人,而执行人的权重则决定它能做什么。

blocks.en:
Harness-level methods refine the agent’s skills and tools while keeping the executor frozen [ 16 , 6 , 18 , 31 , 33 , 38 , 30 , 26 , 17 , 25 ] .
Their changes are cheap, readable and easy to revert, but they stall when a task requires a motion the executor cannot perform [ 33 , 29 ] .
Policy-level methods instead update the executor’s weights [ 12 , 9 , 34 , 5 , 15 , 10 ] , some of them directing training toward tasks with low recent success [ 5 ] or toward high-risk scenarios [ 9 ] , and systems that act on both levels train on the data that a refined harness produces [ 32 , 7 ] .
None of these methods asks whether a persistent failure lies in how the executor is called or in a motion it lacks, although the two call for different remedies.
Training on a failure that lies in how the executor is called is not only costly but also risky, as a fine-tuned policy can perform a sub-step worse than the executor it started from.
blocks.zh:
利用一级方法改进代理人的技能和工具,同时使执行人被冻结[16、6、18、31、33、38、30、26、17、25]。
它们的变化是廉价的、可读的和易于回放的,但当一项任务需要执行人不能执行的动议时,它们会拖延[33、29]。
相反,政策层面的方法更新了执行者的权重[12、9、34、5、15、10],其中一些方法将培训导向最近不太成功的任务[5]或高风险情景[9],在这两个层面发挥作用的系统则根据精炼后产生的数据[32、7]进行培训。
这些方法中没有任何一种方法会问,持续失败是取决于如何称呼执行人,还是取决于它缺乏的动议,尽管这两种方法要求不同的补救办法。
培训失败与否取决于如何称呼执行人不仅代价高昂,而且风险也很大,因为经过微调的政策可以比执行人起步的分步骤更糟糕。

blocks.en:
This raises a question that current embodied RSI leaves open: when should a self-improving system change the weights of its executor?
We argue that the answer is a matter of attribution.
The weights should change only for a sub-step that stays unreliable after the agent has tried other ways of calling the executor, such as other instructions, robot poses or approaches.
Refining the harness first therefore does more than fix the failures that lie in how the executor is called.
It also sets the states from which the executor is called, so that a policy trained afterwards learns the motion that is actually missing, from the states in which it will be used.
blocks.zh:
这就提出了一个目前体现的RSI留下的问题:自我改进的系统何时应改变其执行者的权重?
我们主张,答案是一个归属问题。
权重只应为代理人尝试其他方式,如其他指令,机器人姿势或接近后保持不可靠的子步骤而改变.
因此,首先精炼管子,不仅能弥补执行者被称为什么的故障。
这部法律还规定了要求执行人所属的州,以便随后经过培训的政策从使用该州的州学到实际缺失的动作。

blocks.en:
We answer this question with AdaRSI , an on-demand recursive self-improvement framework for embodied agents.
The agent first refines its harness from execution feedback, so that the harness absorbs the failures that better calling can fix without any training.
It then attributes the failures that persist, retrying a failing sub-step from a saved simulator state under different instructions and approaches, which separates a poor way of calling the executor from a motion it cannot make.
For the sub-steps that no such retry makes reliable, the agent collects demonstrations in simulation and fine-tunes a sub-step policy from the states its harness reaches.
Each new policy is evaluated on held-out start states, and the procedure calls it only where these measurements show that it helps, so a weight change enters the system only after it has been both attributed and validated.
Improvements accumulate over rounds, each starting from the system that the previous round produced.
Experience and a training budget derived from earlier tasks guide later ones, so the system improves not only itself but also the way it improves.
No human demonstrations are used, and privileged simulator state serves only to generate and label data, never at test time.

它然后将持续存在的失败归为属性,在不同的指令和方法下从被保存的模拟状态中重试一个失败的子步骤,这将一个差劲的调用执行者的方法与它无法提出的动议区分开来.
对于没有这种重试使分步骤变得可靠的子步骤,代理收集模拟中的演示,并微调其控制所到达的各州的分步骤政策.
每个新政策在被搁置的起步状态上都得到评价,程序只在这些测量表明有帮助时才称它为"起步",因此重量变化只有在被归属和验证后才进入系统.

blocks.en:
We evaluate on all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365 [ 19 , 20 ] under the official protocol, with GR00T N1.5 [ 21 ] as the executor.
AdaRSI improves the VLA on all three suites, most of all on unseen composite tasks, where it raises success from 4.6% to 13.8%, about three times the base rate.
The harness provides most of this gain, and fine-tuning, which executes only 15% of the manipulation steps, carries the tasks that the harness alone could not solve, such as one that requires opening a microwave door the VLA never opens on its own.
In paired tests from identical states, fine-tuning teaches motions that the executor lacks, but it can degrade sub-steps that the executor already completes.
Compared with fine-tuning every sub-step and calling the new policies by default, AdaRSI reaches slightly higher success while using only 28% of the GPU time and 22% of the self-collected demonstrations.
Fine-tuning without a harness trains more yet gains far less, and its deployed system calls few of the policies it trained.
Training instead the sub-steps on which the executor succeeds least, under the same budget, gains nothing over the harness alone, even though most of the sub-steps it trains are the same, as attribution also tells the agent from which states a missing motion should be learned.
blocks.zh:
根据正式协议,我们评估RoboCasa365 [19,20]的所有50个目标任务,以GR00T N1.5 [21]作为执行者.
AdaRSI改进了所有三套套房的VLA,其中最重要的是隐形复合任务,将成功率从4.6%提高到了13.8%,大约是基准率的三倍.
牵引装置提供了大部分的收益,微调装置只执行15%的操纵步骤,承担了牵引装置单独无法解决的任务,例如需要打开VLA从未单独打开的微波门.
在来自同态的配对测试中,微调会教给执行者所缺少的动作,但它可以降解执行者已经完成的分步骤.
相较于每分步骤的微调和默认调用新政策,AdaRSI取得了略高的成功,同时只使用了28%的GPU时间和22%的自收集演示.
没有牵引装置的微调更是少得多,其部署的系统很少提到其培训的政策。
相反,在同一个预算下,执行人至少取得成功的分步骤,仅靠培训就没有任何好处,尽管它所训练的分步骤大多相同,因为归属还告诉代理人,应该从中了解一个缺失的运动。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We formulate on-demand recursive self-improvement for embodied agents, in which the decision to change the executor’s weights rests on attributing each persistent failure to the harness or to the executor, and instantiate it as AdaRSI. • We find that the harness decides whether training pays off, as it absorbs failures that would otherwise be trained on and sets the states from which policies are trained and called, while fine-tuning teaches motions the executor lacks but can degrade sub-steps it already completes. • We show on all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365, without any human demonstration, that training on demand improves a pretrained VLA on every suite at a fraction of the training cost of fine-tuning every sub-step.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
VLAs map images and language instructions directly to robot actions [ 11 , 1 , 21 ] .
Trained on large and diverse data, they follow instructions in new environments [ 23 , 8 ] , carry out long-horizon tasks with memory [ 27 , 22 ] , and can be paired with a high-level model that decomposes a task [ 24 ] .
Yet they still generalize poorly to tasks outside their training distribution [ 20 , 39 ] .
We keep a pretrained VLA as the executor and let the embodied system built on it improve itself.

VLAs将图像和语言指令直接映射给机器人动作[11, 1, 21].
接受大而多样数据的培训,他们遵循新环境的指示[23,8],执行有内存的长相距任务[27,22],可以与分解任务的高级别模型相配[24].
然而,在培训分配之外的任务方面,他们仍然做得很差[20、39]。
我们保留一个经过预先训练的VLA作为执行者,让建立在它之上的内在系统改善自己.

blocks.en:
Recursive self-improvement (RSI) refers to systems that turn their own experience into persistent changes that make them better [ 4 , 3 ] , as language-model agents have done by rewriting their own code, harness and skills [ 37 , 13 , 36 , 14 ] .
Most embodied methods refine the agent’s skills and harness while the executor stays frozen [ 16 , 6 , 18 , 31 , 33 , 38 , 30 , 26 , 17 , 25 ] .
They change how and when the executor is called, but not what it can do [ 29 ] .
Other methods improve the executor itself by training policies on self-collected data [ 12 , 9 , 34 , 5 , 35 , 15 , 10 ] .
Some of them choose where to train, practicing tasks with low recent success [ 5 ] or collecting high-risk scenarios for a specialist that a gate calls in place of the nominal policy [ 9 ] , and a few act on both levels [ 32 , 7 ] , for example fine-tuning the policy on data that an evolved harness collects [ 32 ] .
These methods choose which failures to train on, but not whether a failure lies in how the executor is called, which a harness change can fix, or in a motion the executor lacks, which calls for new weights.
We instead attribute each persistent failure to one of the two levels before training, and change the weights only for the sub-steps that remain unreliable after the harness has been refined.

多数体现的方法在执行者被冻结时改进了代理人的技能和利用[16、6、18、31、33、38、30、26、17、25]。
它们改变了执行者被叫来的方式和时间,而不是它所能做的[29].
其他方法通过自我收集数据的培训政策改进了执行者本身[12、9、34、5、35、15、10]。
其中一些人选择培训地点,从事最近不太成功的任务[5],或为一个专家收集高风险的假想,而一个门要求取代名义政策[9],少数人在两个级别上采取行动[32、7],例如,调整关于一个进化后收集的数据的政策[32]。
这些方法选择哪些失败是训练失败,而不是失败是在于执行者如何被叫作,一个被操纵的改变可以固定,还是执行者缺乏的运动,这需要新的权重.
相反,我们把每一次持续失败都归结为训练前的两个级别之一,并且只改变在调整后仍然不可靠的分步骤的权重。

blocks.en:
AdaRSI first refines the harness and then descends to the weights.
In the harness rounds, the agent builds its tools and procedure, runs the system on held-out validation episodes, and revises the tools and procedure on this feedback.
The weight round then lets the agent descend to the executor, but only for the sub-steps that remain unreliable after these revisions.
Each round starts from the system that the previous round produced.
The harness is written by the agent for itself: at deployment, a fresh instance of the same agent reads the procedure and calls tools and policies as it prescribes.
blocks.zh:
AdaRSI首先精炼了绳子,再降入重量.
在套接力回合中,代理建立其工具和程序,在被搁置的验证事件上运行系统,并针对这种反馈修改工具和程序.
重量回合让代理人降入执行者,但仅限于这些修改后仍然不可靠的分步骤.
每回合从上一轮生产的系统开始.

blocks.en: 4.1 Harness-Level Improvement
blocks.zh: 4.1 合理改进

blocks.en:
The harness starts minimal.
It exposes only the executor, which runs with a language instruction for a bounded number of steps, the camera images and proprioception, a map of the fixtures in the scene, low-level commands for the base and the arm, and a basic tool that navigates the base to a fixture, as a planning and control module does on a real mobile manipulator.
Everything else is written by the agent, such as tools for fine positioning in front of a fixture, resetting the arm or zooming a camera onto a fixture, among many others.
Improving the harness means writing such tools and strengthening the procedure that calls them.
The procedure tells the deployed agent which sub-steps to perform, which tool or policy to call for each, and how to verify progress.
blocks.zh:
绳子启动得很少
它只暴露出执行器,它运行时带有限定数个步骤的语言指令,相机图像和自控,场景中固定装置的地图,底部和臂部的低等指令,以及一个将底部通向固定装置的基本工具,就像一个规划和控制模块在真正的移动操纵器上一样.
其他的一切都由代理人书写,比如在固定器前精细定位的工具,重置手臂或将相机放大到固定器上等,等等.
改进利用手段意味着编写此类工具并加强使用这些工具的程序。
该程序向部署的代理人说明哪些分步骤要执行,哪些工具或政策需要每个分步骤,以及如何核实进展情况。

blocks.en:
During development, the agent may reset the scene, save and restore simulator snapshots, and query the task’s success check.
Snapshots enable counterfactual re-execution, in which a single sub-step is retried from the same state under a different instruction or approach, and this separates a poor instruction or a poor approach from a motion the executor cannot make.
After each round, the system is run as at deployment on held-out validation episodes, and the records of these runs are returned to the agent as feedback for the next round.
The agent thus tunes its harness on one set of scenes and is judged on another, which exposes failures that only appear in new scenes.
blocks.zh:
开发期间,代理商可能会重新设置场景,保存并恢复模拟快照,并查询任务的成功检查.
抓图可以实现反事实再执行,其中单个子步骤在不同的指令或方法下从同一状态重审,这将一个差指令或差方法与执行者无法提出的动议区分开来.
每轮后,系统运行到被搁置的验证事件部署时,这些运行的记录作为下一轮的反馈返回代理.

blocks.en: 4.2 Descending to the Weights
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 降为重量级

blocks.en:
Descending to the weights begins with failure attribution, which assigns each persistent failure either to the harness or to the executor.
We call a sub-step executor-limited if no harness the agent can find lets π 0 \pi_{0} perform it reliably.
At the end of the harness rounds, the agent records the sub-steps that still fail although the robot is in place and the instruction is one the executor knows, together with the success rate it measured for π 0 \pi_{0} from such states.
These candidates, and the validation records behind them, guide the weight round.
blocks.zh:
降入权重从失败归属开始,它将每次持续失败都指定给被操纵者或执行者.
我们称子步骤执行器是有限的 如果代理商找不到绳索 让\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\}可靠地执行它。

这些候选人,以及他们背后的验证记录,指导了权重回合.

blocks.en:
For a sub-step it decides to train, the agent collects demonstrations in simulation itself.
It can apply rejection sampling to the base executor, rolling it out repeatedly from the failing state and keeping the segments that succeed, or write a scripted expert that reads privileged state such as object poses and articulation states.
This follows learning with privileged information [ 28 , 2 ] , in which a privileged teacher labels data for a student that sees only the robot’s regular observations.
Privileged state is used only here, to generate and label data, and the deployed system never sees it.

对于它决定训练的分步骤,代理在模拟本身中收集演示.
它可以将拒绝抽样应用到底部执行器上,从故障状态中反复地将其推出来并保留成功段,或者写出一个脚本专家来读取对象姿势和表达状态等特权状态.

blocks.en:
Each demonstration set fine-tunes a sub-step policy, starting from π 0 \pi_{0} or from one of the agent’s earlier policies, and the result is added to Π \Pi .
The new policy is called through the same interface as the base executor.
As in self-improving coding agents [ 37 ] , every self-modification is validated empirically.
The agent compares the new policy with π 0 \pi_{0} from development states and records the result in its procedure, which recommends the policy for the sub-steps where it performs better and keeps π 0 \pi_{0} as the default everywhere else.
In the same round, the agent also works out how to call each new policy, for example how the robot is positioned before the call.
Every trained policy stays in Π \Pi , so the deployed agent follows the recommendations of its procedure but can still choose another policy from the library, for instance after π 0 \pi_{0} fails repeatedly.

blocks.en: 4.3 Recursion Across Rounds and Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.3 轮回和任务

blocks.en:
Each round maps the current system and the experience gathered with it to an improved system, S k + 1 = g ⁡ ( S k , ℰ k ) S_{k+1}=g(S_{k},\mathcal{E}_{k}) .
The experience ℰ k \mathcal{E}_{k} contains the development runs, the validation records and, in the weight round, the training results of every policy, adopted or not.
Because the harness and the policies persist, later rounds build on what earlier rounds found, and a harness revision can make use of a newly trained policy as easily as of the base executor.
blocks.zh:
每个圆形图将当前系统及其所收集的经验映射到一个经过改进的系统,Sk + 1 = g → (Sk, Ek) S_{k + 1 → (S_{k},\ mathcal{ E}_{k}).
E k\ mathcal{E}_{k}的经验包含开发运行,验证记录,并在权重回合中包含通过或不通过的每一政策的培训结果.
由于这种管制和政策持续存在,以后的管制以早先的管制办法为基础,管制办法的修订可以像基地执行者那样容易地利用新训练的政策。

blocks.en:
Self-improvement also carries over across tasks.
We select pilot tasks to span high, moderate, and low base-VLA success rates on manipulation sub-steps, measured on development scenes during the harness rounds.
This provides varied starting points for studying when harness refinement suffices and when weight adaptation is useful.
The pilot tasks are improved without any limit on training.
From their training logs, the agent writes an experience document that records which kinds of sub-steps benefited from training, how much data sufficed, and where effort was wasted.
The same logs set a training budget by a fixed rule, scaled from the training that the adopted policies of the pilot tasks actually used.
Every later task is improved with this document and under this budget, which the environment enforces on training steps and self-collected demonstrations.
The budget turns the choice of where to train into an explicit trade-off, and the experience tells the agent which sub-steps are likely to be executor-limited.
In this sense the system improves not only itself but also the way it improves.
blocks.zh:
自我改进也贯穿各项任务。
我们选择试点任务,在操纵分步骤上跨越高、中和低基VLA成功率,在利用轮回期间在开发场景上加以衡量。
这为在适当改进利用和适应重量有用时进行研究提供了不同的起点。

blocks.en:
At deployment, a fresh instance of the agent runs the final system on unseen scenes.
It follows the procedure, calls tools and policies, and checks progress from images, without snapshots, success checks or privileged state.

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
We evaluate on all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365 [ 20 ] , which form three suites.
The 18 Atomic-Seen and 16 Composite-Seen tasks appear in the executor’s training data, while the 16 Composite-Unseen tasks compose familiar sub-tasks into tasks that are absent from it.
We follow the official protocol, with the target split, whose kitchens and objects do not overlap with pretraining, the official task horizons, which also count the steps taken by tools, and the official success check.
Each task is tested on 50 scenes.
Development, validation and test scenes are disjoint, and test scenes are never used during improvement.
We report the success rate of each task, averaged over the tasks of a suite.

blocks.en: 5.2 Main Results
blocks.zh: 5.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
AdaRSI achieves the highest suite-level success rate on all three suites, reaching 48.8% over the 50 tasks compared with 42.4% for the VLA alone and 46.7% for Agent + harness ( Tab. 1 ).
The largest gain is on Composite-Unseen, where success rises from 4.6% to 13.8%, about three times the base executor’s rate.
The gains also extend to tasks present in the executor’s training data, with Atomic-Seen rising from 75.4% to 79.7% and Composite-Seen from 43.0% to 49.0%.
The benefit is thus not confined to acquiring motions for unseen tasks, and improving how existing capabilities are used also raises task success.
blocks.zh:
AdaRSI在所有三个套房中都取得了最高的套房成功率,在50个任务中达到了48.8%,而仅VLA就达到了42.4%,Agent + habel(Tab. 1)达到了46.7%.
最大的收益来自综合-未央视,成功率从4.6%上升到13.8%,大约是基准执行者的三倍。
成果还延伸到执行者培训数据中的任务,原子观测从75.4%上升到79.7%,复合观测从43.0%上升到49.0%。
因此,好处不仅限于为隐形任务获得动议,改进现有能力的使用方式也会带来任务的成功。

blocks.en:
Letting the agent call the VLA without any development does not reliably raise success. Agent + VLA falls from 75.4% to 72.2% on Atomic-Seen, and its overall success remains below that of the VLA alone.
Harness development reverses this drop and improves all three suites, reaching 78.3% on Atomic-Seen and more than doubling success on Composite-Unseen to 9.9%.
In CuttingToolSelection, for example, the agent writes a rule that maps each food to the right tool instead of leaving “the appropriate cutting tool” to the VLA, and adds checks that stop a failing attempt early, raising success from 30% to 50%.
The benefit therefore comes from improving the tools and procedure through execution feedback, rather than simply allowing an agent to issue sub-instructions.
blocks.zh:
任由代理人在没有任何发展的情况下拨打VLA并不能可靠地提高成功. 物剂+活性半衰期从75.4%降至72.2%,其总体成功率仍低于活性半衰期。
利用开发扭转了这一下降趋势并改进了所有三个套房,在原子观测中达到78.3%,而复合观测中的成功率翻了一番以上,达到9.9%。
例如,在Cutting ToolSelection中,代理商写出一条规则,将每个食物都映射到正确的工具上,而不是将“适当的剪接工具”留在VLA上,并添加了停止早期失败尝试的检查,将成功率从30%提高到了50%.
因此,好处在于通过执行反馈改进工具和程序,而不仅仅是允许代理人发布次级指令。

blocks.en:
The weight round adds the most on Composite-Unseen, a further 3.9 percentage points against 1.4 on Atomic-Seen and 1.0 on Composite-Seen. Table 2 breaks this gain down by task.
WaffleReheat shows the largest effect, rising from 0% with the harness alone to 38% with AdaRSI.
Its harness reaches the microwave, but π 0 \pi_{0} cannot open the door and release the handle, and a policy fine-tuned for this sub-step resolves the bottleneck while π 0 \pi_{0} still performs every other step.
RecycleBottlesByType improves from 0% to 18% and BreadSelection from 42% to 52%, so the weight round helps both tasks that rarely succeed and tasks where the harness already does well.
Not every task benefits, however.
CuttingToolSelection falls from 50% to 36% after the weight round, and several tasks remain unsolved by every system although the agent fine-tunes policies for their sub-steps.
We return to these cases in Sec. 6 .

A paired test from identical states isolates what the fine-tuned weights themselves change ( Tab. 4 ).
We replay a test episode up to the first call of a policy, save a snapshot, and let π 0 \pi_{0} and the fine-tuned policy execute the same instruction for the same number of steps, with privileged state judging success.
On motions beyond π 0 \pi_{0} , fine-tuning teaches what is missing. π 0 \pi_{0} opens the microwave door in none of 18 kitchens and the fine-tuned policy in 7, and the mean opening rises from 0.01 to 0.61, while the glass bottle is picked up in 17 of 44 starts against 2.
On motions that π 0 \pi_{0} already performs, such as placing the croissant or the jam on the cutting board, fine-tuning lowers success.
The same training thus helps where the executor falls short and hurts where it does not, which is the case for training on demand.

blocks.en: 5.3 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5.3 违约

blocks.en:
We ablate AdaRSI on the Composite-Unseen suite with five variants.
(1) Agent + weights improves the system only by fine-tuning, without harness rounds, tools or a training budget.
(2) Agent + harness improves only the harness and stops before the weight round.

blocks.en:
Both levels help on their own, but neither reaches their combination.
Fine-tuning without a harness lifts the VLA from 4.6% to 7.2%, and the harness alone reaches 9.9%, while AdaRSI reaches 13.8% on the same episodes.
The harness is the larger lever, since most failures come from the procedure rather than from missing motions.
It also does more than raise success, because it tells the agent where training is needed.
Without harness rounds, the agent trains more than AdaRSI, 45 policies against 38 and 1.25 × \times the GPU time, yet the deployed system calls only 5 of them, against 32 for AdaRSI ( Tab. 3 ).
Many of these policies take on work that a tool would do, such as moving the base or carrying an object across the kitchen, and others are trained from wherever the robot happens to stand.
In WaffleReheat, for instance, both systems train a policy for the microwave door, but only AdaRSI trains it from the pose to which its tools bring the robot, so only its policy is ever used, and the task succeeds in 38% of episodes against 4% for the agent without harness rounds.
The harness thus attributes failures to the executor and fixes the states from which a policy is trained and called, which is what makes training on demand effective.

牵引力是更大的杠杆,因为大多数失败来自程序而不是缺失的动议。
它不仅能提高成功,而且还能告诉代理人需要培训的地方。
没有被套弹,特工的训练次数超过AdaRSI,45个政策对38和1.25 ×\时间为GPU时间,然而部署的系统只呼叫了其中的5个,而AdaRSI(Tab. 3)则为32个.
这些政策中很多都承担了一种工具会做的工作,比如移动基座或携带物体过厨房,其他的则从机器人恰好站的地方接受训练.
例如,在WaffleReheat中,两个系统都对微波门进行政策培训,但只有AdaRSI从它的工具给机器人带来的姿势上对其进行培训,所以只有它的政策被使用过,任务在38%的事件中获得成功,而对于没有拉带子弹的特工来说是4%。
因此,这种手段将失败归咎于执行者,并修正了政策培训和调用所依赖的州,这就使得按要求培训有效。

The loss in CuttingToolSelection already appears with the revised procedure alone, which we return to in Sec. 6 .
Fine-tuning and the procedure built around it thus contribute about equally, and the weights carry the tasks that no procedure can solve.

Fine-tuning every manipulation sub-step does not improve on AdaRSI ( Tab. 7 ).
It reaches 12.6% against 13.8% on the same episodes, while it trains 3.1 × \times as many policies, collects 4.5 × \times as many demonstrations and uses 3.5 × \times the GPU time.
The task-level results show why.
In WaffleReheat, training everywhere replaces every sub-step, including picking up the bowl, which π 0 \pi_{0} already performs reliably, and the new policy does it worse, so success drops from 38% to 28%.
In WashFruitColander, most of the twelve new policies do not beat π 0 \pi_{0} on held-out starts, and success drops from 58% to 34%, partly because calling many policies also slows each episode until some reach the time limit.
Training everywhere helps where AdaRSI left a useful sub-step untrained, most clearly in RecycleBottlesByType, where policies that carry and place each bottle raise success from 18% to 30%.
Overall, most of the extra training buys nothing, and training everywhere is not an appropriate default, because a fine-tuned policy can replace an executor call that already worked.

任务层面的结果表明原因。
在WaffleReheat中,各地的训练都取代了每一个分步骤,包括取出碗来,这个碗已经运行得可靠,而新政策更糟糕,所以成功率从38%下降到了28%.
在WashFruit Colander中,12个新政策中的大部分并没有在被搁置开始时击败 ^ 0\\pi\0}成功率从58%下降到了34%,部分原因是许多政策在达到时限之前也会放慢每集的速度。
各地的培训都有助于AdaRSI留下一个有用的子步骤未经过训练的地方,最明显的是RecycleBottlesByType,其中携带和放置每瓶的政策将成功率从18%提高到了30%.
总体而言,大多数额外培训都买不到任何东西,各地的培训都不是适当的默认,因为经过微调的政策可以取代已经有效的执行者调用.

blocks.en:
A simpler rule could decide where to train without attributing failures, by training the sub-steps on which π 0 \pi_{0} succeeds least. Lowest first applies this rule on the Composite-Unseen tasks that are not pilots.
It starts from the same harness as AdaRSI, with the same budget, demonstration collection and adoption rule, measures π 0 \pi_{0} on every manipulation sub-step from the states that the procedure reaches, and trains as many sub-steps per task as AdaRSI does, lowest success first, without retrying any of them from other states or with other instructions.
It gains nothing over the harness alone, reaching 11.8% against 12.0%, while AdaRSI reaches 16.6% at a similar training cost ( Tab. 8 ).
Where it trains, the rule mostly selects the same sub-steps as AdaRSI, 11 of the 13 it trains, yet it does not turn them into gains.
In WaffleReheat, both systems train a policy for the microwave door, but only AdaRSI, which retries the failing sub-step before training, finds that its failure depends on how the hand approaches the handle and trains from an approach that works, so the task succeeds in 38% of episodes against 2%.
Measuring every sub-step also takes time, and in four tasks it used up the development session before any policy was trained.
Attribution thus tells the agent not only which sub-steps to train but also from which states to learn them.

在WaffleReheat中,两个系统都对微波门进行政策训练,但只有AdaRSI在训练前对失败的子步骤进行再试,发现它的失败取决于手如何从有效的方法接近手柄并进行训练,因此任务成功率在38%的相比于2%.
衡量每一个分步骤也需要时间,在四项任务中,在培训任何政策之前,它都用了发展课程。
因此,归属不仅告诉代理人要训练哪个分步骤,而且要从哪个分步骤中学习。

blocks.en:
At deployment, the agent uses execution feedback to adjust how it calls tools and policies, revising sub-goals, instructions and recovery actions as the task unfolds.
The fixed-procedure variant also responds to feedback, but its choices are limited to the conditions and responses encoded in advance.
To evaluate the value of this adaptation, we execute the final procedure and policies of AdaRSI as a fixed program, with privileged simulator state available for state estimation.
The fixed program reaches 6.9% success against 13.8% for AdaRSI, despite this information advantage ( Tab. 5 ).
The largest drops occur on tasks that require choosing a standing position from the current view or changing approach after a failure, as WaffleReheat falls from 38% to 4% and WashFruitColander from 58% to 28% ( Tab. 2 ).
By contrast, on CuttingToolSelection, whose procedure follows fixed steps, the program reaches 40% against 36% for AdaRSI.
These results support keeping the agent in the execution loop.
It adjusts how it uses its tools and policies to the observed state, beyond the responses predefined in the fixed program.

在部署时,代理机构利用执行反馈来调整它如何调用工具和政策,随着任务展开而修订次级目标,指令和恢复行动.
固定程序变体也响应了反馈,但其选择仅限于事先编码的条件和响应.
为了评价这种适应的价值,我们执行AdaRSI作为固定程序的最后程序和政策,并有可供状态估计的特权模拟状态.
固定方案的成功率为6.9%,而AdaRSI的成功率为13.8%,尽管有这一信息优势(图5)。
由于WaffleReheat从38%下降到4%,WashFruit Colander从58%下降到了28%(附件2)。
相比之下,在Cutting ToolSelection上(其程序遵循固定步骤),该方案达到40%,而AdaRSI为36%。
这些结果支持使代理保持执行循环.
它调整它如何使用它的工具和政策来适应被观测到的状态,超越了固定程序中预先定义的响应.

blocks.en: 5.4 Cost
blocks.zh: 5.4 费用

blocks.en:
On the Composite-Unseen suite, AdaRSI trains 2.4 policies per task on average, adopted or not, using 26 self-collected demonstrations, 1.9k updates and about one GPU-hour.
Its improvement phase, including the harness rounds, validation and the weight round, consumes 154M input tokens and 0.64M output tokens per task, and at deployment the agent uses 4.2M input and 7.2k output tokens per episode, with about 97% of the input tokens being cache hits.
The improvement phase costs 117M and 137M input tokens per task on Atomic-Seen and Composite-Seen, where deployment needs 1.2M and 1.9M per episode, since the procedures are shorter.
Fine-tuning every sub-step raises the deployment cost to 5.3M input tokens per episode, because the agent calls and checks more policies, while fine-tuning without a harness needs fewer tokens per episode, 1.5M, but fails more often.
No human demonstration is used at any stage.

blocks.en:
To see how the agent decides where to train, we analyze the weight rounds of the pilot tasks, which run without a training budget and whose records produce the experience document. Table 9 sorts representative policies by whether π 0 \pi_{0} could already perform the sub-step and whether fine-tuning improved it on held-out starts.
When a sub-step is beyond π 0 \pi_{0} , a few demonstrations can teach it, as twenty demonstrations do for the left door of a French-door refrigerator in GarnishPancake.
The task still fails there, because later sub-steps remain unsolved, so learning one motion does not by itself make a long task succeed.
Other missing motions are learned only partly, such as picking up the skewer, or not at all, such as closing the toaster-oven door.
When π 0 \pi_{0} already performs a sub-step, training can still raise its reliability, as for the mug in CoffeeSetupMug, but it often leaves the sub-step unchanged or yields a gain in development that does not hold at test, as for the drawer in OpenDrawer.
The experience document summarizes such cases for the tasks that follow.

其它缺失的动作只是部分地学习到,比如取出起起起子,或者完全没有,比如关闭烤面包机-吸取出子的门.

blocks.en:
Figure 4 follows two tasks through the system and shows when each level of improvement is the right one.
In WashFruitColander ( Fig. 4 a), the VLA puts fruit into the sink before placing the colander, then leaves the fruit outside it.
The harness instead places the colander first and puts in each fruit with a short instruction.
When the faucet attempts produce no water, the agent inspects the scene and uses its working-pose tool to reposition the base before retrying, completing the task without training any policy.
GetToastedBread ( Fig. 4 b) fails for a different reason.
After the toast pops up, the base VLA rolls the wrist without grasping the bread, and resetting the arm and re-parking the base before retrying still leave it in the toaster.
AdaRSI uses a policy fine-tuned for bread pickup with the same instruction, retrieving the bread in two 160-step calls.
The robot then navigates with the bread held, and π 0 \pi_{0} places it on the plate.
The two tasks thus call for different levels of improvement, and AdaRSI applies each only where it is needed.

机器人然后用所持的面包来导航,然后将面包放入盘子上.
因此,这两项任务需要不同程度的改进,而AdaRSI仅适用于需要的地方。

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Our results support a simple principle for embodied self-improvement, to change the harness first and to change the weights only for the sub-steps that stay unreliable once the harness has been refined.
Our instantiation of this principle leaves two decisions to the agent, and it can fail at either.
The agent may find the sub-steps that need training but not obtain a policy that performs them reliably.
This happens in the Composite-Unseen tasks that remain unsolved, which chain several sub-steps beyond the executor and succeed only if every fine-tuned policy in the chain succeeds in the same episode.
The agent may also adopt a change that looks better on a few development scenes but hurts on the test scenes.
In CuttingToolSelection, the weight round starts every episode that needs the peeler with a dedicated grasp step, which looked slightly better in development but halves success in these episodes at test, whether the step runs the fine-tuned policy or π 0 \pi_{0} .
Both depend on the capability of the agent and on how training is constrained, including the budget, the number of validation scenes and the way demonstrations are collected.
A more reliable test of necessity and a stronger training loop are natural next steps, and so is restricting the deployed agent to the policies that its procedure selects, which our agent may override after repeated failures.

我们对这一原则的即时解释使两个决定权交给代理人,而它也可能失败。
代理人可能找到需要培训的分步骤,但没有获得可靠履行这些政策的政策。

代理商也可能采用在几个开发场景上看起来较好,但在测试场景上却伤害到的改变.

对必要性的更可靠的检验和更有力的培训循环是下一个自然步骤,而且将部署的代理人限制于其程序所选择的政策,我们的代理人在屡次失败后可能会推翻这些政策。

blocks.en:
All experiments run in simulation, where privileged state makes it easy to generate and label demonstrations.
On a real robot, the same role would have to be played by success detectors, scripted resets or occasional human help, and the cost of a weight change would rise accordingly, which only strengthens the case for training on demand.
We are conducting real-robot experiments and will include them in the next version of this paper.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented AdaRSI, an on-demand recursive self-improvement framework for embodied agents.
It lets a coding agent improve its skills and harness first and fine-tune the executor only on the sub-steps that remain unreliable, using demonstrations it collects itself.
Across all 50 target tasks of RoboCasa365 and without any human demonstration, this improves a pretrained VLA on all three suites, most of all on unseen composite tasks.
The trained weights pay off where the executor lacks a motion, and there they decide whether a task succeeds, whereas fine-tuning a sub-step that the executor already completes often adds cost without adding success and can even make it worse.
Deciding where to train thus lets embodied self-improvement gain from new weights at a fraction of the cost of training everywhere.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了AdaRSI, 即一个针对特定代理人的按需自我改进框架。
它让一个编码代理者提高其技能,首先利用执行者,并且只在仍然不可靠的分步骤上微调执行者,使用它自己收集的演示.
在RoboCasa365的所有50个目标任务中,在没有任何人类演示的情况下,这改善了所有三个套房的预先训练的VLA,其中最重要的是无形的综合任务.
训练有素的权重在被执行人缺少动议的情况下得到回报,在那里他们决定一项任务是否成功,而被执行人已经完成的分步骤的微调往往会增加成本而不会增加成功,甚至会更糟糕.
因此,在决定培训地点时,可以体现自我改善,从新的重量中获得好处,其成本是各地培训费用的一小部分。
